record_title: Exact early section radii for higher Neil constraints
provenance: Higher-order extension of the Fejer-Rogosinski section problem initiated for the Neil algebra by Das--Sarkar, arXiv:2609.17114, using the classical Szasz coefficient extremal theorem as restated in Kovalev, arXiv:2507.04544.
limitations: The optimal radius valid simultaneously for all section orders of the higher constraint algebra is not determined. Exact fixed-offset formulas require zero-freeness of the relevant Szasz extremal polynomial at the candidate radius; only the stated ranges are claimed. Sections beyond offset m contain nonlinear powers of the Schwarz factor. Manning's 1942 paper and Nabetani's 1935 section papers were not independently inspected in full and remain residual originality risks. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
